"assistant", "text": "很可能是这个原因。你的判断方向基本正确——**内存(RAM)+swap 被占满,是 Ubuntu 卡死的最常见原因**。但需要先确认,再对症下药。我帮你分析并给出排查和解决方案。\n\n## 为什么内存满了会卡死\n\nUbuntu 的内存管理机制:\n\n1. **RAM(15.2G)用完后**,系统开始用 **swap(2G)**——swap 是把磁盘当内存用,速度比 RAM 慢几十到几百倍。\n2. **swap 也用完后**,Linux 触发 **OOM(Out Of Memory)**,开始杀进程保命;在杀掉关键进程前,系统会因为疯狂换页(thrashing)而**卡死**——鼠标不动、键盘无响应。\n3. 即使 swap 没满,**只要 RAM 用尽、开始大量换页**,系统就会卡到几乎不可用,因为磁盘 I/O chips/bk7258/wifi/bk7258_wifi_osal.c-378-  /* The _uninterruptible variants, to match the FreeRTOS contract the pinned
chips/bk7258/wifi/bk7258_wifi_osal.c-379-   * vendor library was built against.
chips/bk7258/wifi/bk7258_wifi_osal.c-380-   *
chips/bk7258/wifi/bk7258_wifi_osal.c-381-   * xSemaphoreTake() (cp/components/bk_rtos/freertos/v10/rtos_pub.c) has exactly
chips/bk7258/wifi/bk7258_wifi_osal.c-382-   * two outcomes: taken, or timed out.  FreeRTOS has no EINTR, so the vendor
chips/bk7258/wifi/bk7258_wifi_osal.c-383-   * callers treat "not taken" as "timed out" -- rw_msg_send() (rw_msg_tx.c:129)
chips/bk7258/wifi/bk7258_wifi_osal.c-384-   * maps any failure to RWNX_ERR_TIMEOUT and abandons the request, losing the
chips/bk7258/wifi/bk7258_wifi_osal.c-385-   * CFM it was waiting for.
chips/bk7258/wifi/bk7258_wifi_osal.c-386-   *
chips/bk7258/wifi/bk7258_wifi_osal.c-387-   * NuttX's nxsem_wait()/nxsem_tickwait() add a third outcome, -EINTR, when a
chips/bk7258/wifi/bk7258_wifi_osal.c-388-   * signal reaches the waiting thread (sem_wait.c:67).  Our wrapper in
chips/bk7258/wifi/bk7258_wifi_osal.c:389:   * glue/rtos_compat_shim.c collapses every negative return to BK_FAIL, so a
chips/bk7258/wifi/bk7258_wifi_osal.c-390-   * spurious wakeup was indistinguishable from a real timeout.  The
chips/bk7258/wifi/bk7258_wifi_osal.c-391-   * _uninterruptible forms retry on EINTR, and the timed one recomputes the
chips/bk7258/wifi/bk7258_wifi_osal.c-392-   * remaining delay from the original deadline (semaphore.h:1048-1071) so the
chips/bk7258/wifi/bk7258_wifi_osal.c-393-   * total timeout is preserved, not extended.
chips/bk7258/wifi/bk7258_wifi_osal.c-394-   *
chips/bk7258/wifi/bk7258_wifi_osal.c-395-   * HONEST SCOPE: this is NOT proven to be the cause of the intermittent
chips/bk7258/wifi/bk7258_wifi_osal.c-396-   * rw_msg_send timeouts seen on the board (reqid 1 / 6173 / 7169 / 7172) -- no
chips/bk7258/wifi/bk7258_wifi_osal.c-397-   * -EINTR was ever captured, and nothing in this profile is known to signal
chips/bk7258/wifi/bk7258_wifi_osal.c-398-   * these threads.  It is fixed because it is a demonstrable divergence from the
chips/bk7258/wifi/bk7258_wifi_osal.c-399-   * contract the library assumes, of the same class as the four board bugs
chips/bk7258/wifi/bk7258_wifi_osal.c-400-   * already found, and because leaving it in keeps an unfalsifiable variable in
chips/bk7258/wifi/bk7258_wifi_osal.c-401-   * every timing measurement.

chips/bk7258/wifi/bk7258_wifi_osal.c-188- * hint only. IRQ producers never wait on either semaphore.

  uint32_t sequence = 0;

  /* Record only finite waits.  Infinite worker waits are expected to survive

      trace->timeout_ms = timeout_ms;
      trace->caller = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)__builtin_return_address(0);
      trace->magic = BK7258_SEM_WAIT_MAGIC;

        bk7258_wifi_osal_sem_wait((uintptr_t)*sem, timeout_ms);

      if (trace->magic == BK7258_SEM_WAIT_MAGIC &&
          trace->sequence == sequence)

          trace->active = 0;

<skill_content name="bk7258-worktree-build">
# Skill: bk7258-worktree-build

# BK7258 Worktree Build

## Complete workflow

Prefer the bundled end-to-end wrapper. Without `--flash` it performs the safe
build, L1 validation, package, independent decode, and package-integrity gate:

```bash
<skill-dir>/scripts/full_flow.sh \
  --workspace <openvela-workspace> \
  --worktree <feature-worktree> \
  --jobs 12
```

The wrapper derives one stable slot per worktree under
`cmake_out/bk7258-worktrees/`. Its `build/cp` and optional `build/ap` directories
are reused for normal Vela incremental builds, and its `package` directory is
safely replaced on each successful package run. A binding file ties the slot to
the canonical workspace/worktree paths, so another worktree cannot reuse it.
If a component defconfig changes, only that component's generated build cache
is recreated. Use `--fresh` to deliberately recreate this worktree's generated
build cache. Use `--slot NAME` only to choose a stable human-readable slot.

To flash, rerun in an interactive terminal and explicitly add `--flash`:

```bash
<skill-dir>/scripts/full_flow.sh \
  --workspace <openvela-workspace> \
  --worktree <feature-worktree> \
  --flash --device /dev/ttyUSB0
```

To flash an existing verified package without rebuilding or requiring a
workspace/worktree, give the image and the board tools directory explicitly:

```bash
<skill-dir>/scripts/full_flow.sh \
  --image /absolute/path/to/all-app.bin \
  --tools-dir /absolute/path/to/board/bk7258-devkit/tools \
  --flash --device /dev/ttyUSB0
```

Image-only mode requires `manifest.json` and `decode-report.json` next to the
image. It runs the same independent integrity gate and automatic flash wrapper
but skips build/package. `--worktree <feature-worktree>` may replace
`--tools-dir`; the wrapper then derives `board/bk7258-devkit/tools` from that
worktree.

Flashing is destructive and must use an interactive terminal. The PTY wrapper
streams the loader output without buffering and drives the reset itself: once
the loader prints `connect success`, the wrapper opens the same serial device
as a second writer and injects `reboot bootloader` into the running NSH
console. Target firmware carrying the bootloader-reset patch
(`feature/bk7258-bootloader-reset`, `board_reset`
`ENTER_BOOTLOADER` via AON WDT) then performs a chip-level reset with the
vendor warm-jump tag cleared and the reset reason recorded as watchdog, so
the BootROM runs the cold chain and BL2 opens the download listen window
that the already-polling loader catches by itself -- no manual reset.
`Gotten Bus...` produces the handshake-success banner. If the automatic
reset does not engage within a few seconds (firmware without the patch, a
hung console), the wrapper retries once and then falls back to bell-and-
prompt manual resets, numbered 1, 2, ...; press reset on each prompt and
stop after the success banner. Never press reset after `Begin EraseFlash`,
and never type into the terminal during the automatic phase.

The public workflow assumes a trusted, current-user-owned workspace and Git
worktree. It does not defend against malicious processes running as the same
Unix user, SIGKILL, power loss, or tools that ignore its mapping lock. It never
runs worktree scripts through `sudo` and refuses to
run as root. Give the normal user access to the serial device through the
platform's serial-device group (commonly `dialout`). Before writing, the
wrapper verifies the audited `bk_loader` SHA-256, prints the complete image
SHA-256. The explicit `--flash` flag is the authorization switch. The agent
must still announce the target device and complete image hash in commentary
immediately before launching it.

When an agent launches the flash stage for the user, it must first announce in
commentary the target device, the complete image SHA-256, and that the wrapper
injects `reboot bootloader` automatically (manual-reset fallback prompts
appear only if the auto reset does not engage), then run the command with
interactive terminal support. Never launch `--flash` in the background,
through redirected output, or in a non-interactive shell. Keep the turn open
until `Writing Flash OK` or a clear failure is reported.

The existing board scripts remain the authority: `bk7258-package.sh` must
produce `decode pass`, and `bk7258-flash.sh` must reproduce the report, validate
all hashes, save the loader log, and find `Writing Flash OK`.

## Scope

This workflow is for a BK7258 team-repository worktree whose sources are
linked into the parent OpenVela workspace. The parent workspace is the
directory containing both `build.sh` and `nuttx/`; it is not the team-repository
checkout and not the worktree directory itself.

Never build a BK7258 worktree by passing `board/bk7258-devkit/configs/cp` to
`build.sh`. That path is valid for repository-local Python tools, but
`build.sh`/`lunch` resolves board configs through the manifest path under
`vendor/beken/boards/...`.

## 1. Establish the worktree mapping

For normal worktree builds, use the bundled wrapper; it serializes access to
the shared mapping and restores both links on exit:

```bash
<skill-dir>/scripts/build_worktree.sh \
  --workspace <openvela-workspace> \
  --worktree <feature-worktree> \
  --component cp \
  --jobs 12
```

Use `--component ap` for AP. Use `--output /absolute/output/path` only for an
isolated build whose artifacts will be passed explicitly to packaging.

From the parent OpenVela workspace, verify the mapped paths:

```bash
readlink -f vendor/beken/chips/bk7258
readlink -f vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-devkit
```

For a feature worktree, both targets must resolve into that worktree:

```text
<worktree>/chips/bk7258
<worktree>/board/bk7258-devkit
```

If they point at another checkout, stop and resolve the mapping before
building. In a shared workspace, changing symlinks is visible to other
processes. Prefer a serialized build, save both original link targets, and
restore them in a shell `trap` even when the build fails. Do not delete the
symlink targets or use a broad recursive cleanup.

The project manifest is the source of truth for the normal mapping. The build
tree consumes the mapped `vendor/` paths, while packaging scripts may be run
from the worktree because they locate the workspace by the `build.sh` and
`nuttx/` markers.

## 2. Configure and build CP/AP

Run from the parent workspace. Use the mapped path and keep the trailing slash:

```bash
./build.sh vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-devkit/configs/cp/ --cmake -j12
./build.sh vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-devkit/configs/ap/ --cmake -j12
```

For a CP-only or Wi-Fi-disabled platform change, the first command is the
minimum build. Confirm the generated `.config` does not enable Wi-Fi/WPA when
the acceptance requires a normal CP configuration with Wi-Fi disabled.

`build.sh` derives output names from the board/config selection. Do not add a
random `-b` directory unless the task explicitly needs isolation:

```text
cmake_out/bk7258-devkit_cp/bk7258/app.bin
cmake_out/bk7258-devkit_cp/bk7258/nuttx.elf
cmake_out/bk7258-devkit_cp/bk7258/l1-validation.json
cmake_out/bk7258-devkit_ap/bk7258_ap/app1.bin
cmake_out/bk7258-devkit_ap/bk7258_ap/l1-validation.json
```

The normal build command supplies the project environment and compiler wrapper.
Direct `cmake --build` can fail with missing `ccache` or stale source paths and
is not equivalent evidence.

## 3. Package and independently decode

The default flow builds and packages the real CP plus OpenVela AP AMP image.
The bundled AP placeholder is recovery-only and must be selected explicitly
with `--placeholder`; it is expected to fail CPU1 AP release validation at
runtime.

For the repository-bundled recovery package, the project wrapper is the
preferred path:

```bash
<worktree>/board/bk7258-devkit/tools/bk7258-package.sh
```

It reads the CP/AP outputs, selects the real OpenVela AP profile, and runs the
independent decoder. The wrapper must print `decode       pass` before an image
is considered valid.

The default package slot intentionally replaces its previous package after the
new CP/AP build and L1 validation pass. `all-app.bin`, `manifest.json`, and
`decode-report.json` remain bound and are verified together before flashing.
Copy that trio elsewhere explicitly when a run must be preserved as historical
hardware evidence.

The package wrapper validates both L1 reports, invokes the container packer,
and independently decodes the final linear-CRC image. Do not flash `app.bin`
or `app1.bin` directly.

## 4. Offline regression checks

Run from the parent workspace or pass paths explicitly:

```bash
python3 <worktree>/board/bk7258-devkit/tests/test_bk7258_bundled_packaging.py
```

text: 这次栈的关键事实已反解出来：`R4=0x28070ca4` 是 NuttX 的 `g_idletcb`，而不是 Wi‑Fi semaphore wrapper；其 `waitobj` 字段却变成了 `0x28070ca0`，即全局 `g_running_tasks` 的地址。换言之，SysTick 正在替“idle TCB”取消一个根本不可能合法的 timed semaphore wait。先前把它归因到 wrapper 布局是错误方向；我不会据此回退 wrapper。现在查是谁把 idle TCB / waitobj 写坏，以及校准代码如何取到这个异常地址。

这次复测说明：我加的 `.noinit` wait tracing 已被排除，但它不是根因。移除后，断言仍在同一条有限超时路径发生。

现在能由 ELF 和 UART 寄存器直接证明的事实是：

```text
nxsem_timeout()
  → nxsem_wait_irq(g_idletcb, ETIMEDOUT)
  → ASSERT(NXSEM_COUNT(g_idletcb->waitobj) < 0)
```

而这次 dump 中：

```text
R4 = 0x28070ca4 = g_idletcb
R3 = 0x28070ca0 = &g_running_tasks
```

`nxsem_wait_irq()` 的反汇编表明它从 `R4 + 0x78` 取 `waitobj`，所以当时实际状态是：

```text
g_idletcb.waitobj == &g_running_tasks
```

这不可能是合法的 Wi‑Fi semaphore wait：

- `g_idletcb` 是 CPU0 的 idle TCB，idle task 不允许进入阻塞 semaphore wait；
- `&g_running_tasks` 是 NuttX 调度器的全局“当前运行任务指针槽”，不是 semaphore；
- `nxsem_timeout()` 的 watchdog 参数也恰好是 `g_idletcb`，说明某个有限 timed wait 曾以 idle TCB 作为 `this_task()` 注册，而不是普通 Wi‑Fi / NSH 线程。

因此，`sem_waitirq.c:137` 只是最后发现不变量已坏的位置，不是根因；也不是校准代码在 IRQ 中直接调用了 wait。

目前有一个已确认、但尚不能单独解释 idle-TCB 损坏的 RTOS shim 缺陷：

```c
beken_thread_t *rtos_get_current_thread(void)
{
  static beken_thread_t current;
  current = (beken_thread_t)(uintptr_t)pthread_self();
  return ¤t;
}
```

它返回的是共享静态存储地址 `0x28075ddc`，而不是当前线程的 opaque handle 值。Armino 返回的是 handle 值强转后的指针。这会让 scan/event 的 thread-id token 错乱，可能造成错误的 completion 匹配或错误唤醒；但现有证据不能把它直接等同于本次 `g_idletcb.waitobj` 损坏。

我不会基于这个猜测继续改 semaphore wrapper、timer shim 或校准调用链。下一步需要抓“第一次写坏”的现场，而不是再扩大改动范围。最有效的方法是通过 SWD/GDB 在 RAM 地址 `0x28070d1c`（`g_idletcb + waitobj`，即 `0x28070ca4 + 0x78`）设置硬件写 watchpoint；任何代码将它写为 `0x28070ca0` 时立即停住，就能得到真正的 PC 和调用栈。

若你的 GDB 已连上目标，可用：

```gdb
watch *(unsigned int *)0x28070d1c
continue
```

命中后立即执行：

```gdb
info registers
bt
x/16wx 0x28070ca4
x/8wx 0x28070ca0
```

关键不是断言后的栈，而是 watchpoint 第一次命中的写入 PC。拿到那组输出后，就能区分：

1. `nxsem_wait_slow()` 在错误的 idle `this_task()` 上运行；
2. 某个调度/线程生命周期路径把 `g_running_tasks` 指向了错误 TCB；
3. 某个越界写直接覆盖了 idle TCB。

你说得对：**中断上下文里绝对不能阻塞等信号量**。但这份 log 需要区分两件事：

1. 最终断言确实发生在中断里；
2. 原始的 `rtos_get_semaphore()` 是否是在中断里调用。

这次能确认的是第 1 点，暂时不能直接证明第 2 点。

`xPSR = 0x2800000f` 表明当前是异常号 15，也就是 SysTick。有限超时的 NuttX 正常流程本来就是：

```text
任务上下文：
  nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(...)
    → 给当前任务的 waitdog 设置超时回调 nxsem_timeout

SysTick 中断：
  nxsem_timeout(...)
    → nxsem_wait_irq(...)
    → 取消超时的 waiter
```

所以 `sem_waitirq.c:137` 在中断里出现，本身是“有限等待超时处理”应该发生的位置；它不等价于“校准代码从 ISR 直接调用了 wait”。

而且当前 OSAL 在进入真正的 wait 之前已经有这层保护：

```c
if (up_interrupt_context())
  {
    return -EAGAIN;
  }
```

如果某个 Wi‑Fi ISR 直接走到 `bk7258_wifi_osal_sem_wait()`，它应当直接返回 `-EAGAIN`，不会进入 `nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible()`，更不会留下一个之后由 SysTick 处理的 timed waiter。

真正异常的是这两个状态：

```text
nxsem_timeout() 收到的 waiter TCB = g_idletcb
该 TCB 的 waitobj = &g_running_tasks
```

它们都不合法：

```text
g_idletcb          = NuttX idle task 的 TCB
&g_running_tasks   = NuttX 调度器全局指针槽
```

都不是校准应等待的 semaphore。

所以目前更准确的结论是：

```text
不是已证实的“ISR 内直接 wait”
而是某个有限 wait 的 watchdog / TCB / scheduler 状态已经损坏，
直到 SysTick 超时回调进入 nxsem_wait_irq() 才被 NuttX 断言发现。
```

你没有 GDB 也没关系，不需要依赖 GDB。下一步不该再加全局 `.noinit` wait trace；更合适的是加一个只在异常条件触发的保护：

```c
/* bk7258_wifi_osal_sem_wait_raw() 中，在 finite wait 前 */

if (timeout_ms != 0 &&
    timeout_ms != BK7258_WIFI_WAIT_FOREVER &&
    sched_idletask())
  {
    /* UART 输出一次固定错误标志后返回，不进入 timed wait */
    return -EDEADLK;
  }
```

它的意义不是“修好根因”，而是验证关键分支：

- 如果 UART 出现这个错误，说明调用 timed wait 时 NuttX 已经把当前任务错误识别成 idle；问题发生在 wait 之前的调度状态。
- 如果不会出现、但仍在 SysTick 的 `nxsem_timeout()` 崩溃，说明正常线程已经启动了 wait，随后其 waitdog 或 TCB 被别处覆盖；问题是内存/生命周期破坏。
- 这个保护不会给正常有限 wait 增加 tracing 写入、临界区或 `.noinit` 存储，也不会在 ISR 中打印或等待。

另外，有一个应当修正但不能单独当作本次根因的确定 bug：

```c
beken_thread_t *rtos_get_current_thread(void)
{
  static beken_thread_t current;
  current = (beken_thread_t)(uintptr_t)pthread_self();
  return ¤t;
}
```

它返回的是所有线程共享的静态变量地址，而不是当前线程 handle。应与 Armino 的历史 ABI 一致，直接返回 handle 值的指针表示：

```c
beken_thread_t *rtos_get_current_thread(void)
{
  return (beken_thread_t *)(uintptr_t)pthread_self();
}
```

这个问题会让 scan/event 的线程身份 token 错乱，可能导致错误 completion 匹配或错误 semaphore post；但不能仅凭它断言就是当前 idle-TCB 损坏的唯一原因。

这次已经越过之前的 semaphore 断言；`calibration_main ... over` 之后没有再崩。

但“停在 `pwr_gain`”不能直接归因到那条日志。静态反汇编确认：

```text
rwnx_cal_set_txpwr(40, 54)
  → rwnx_tpc_pa_map_init()
  → rwnx_use_tpc_set_pwr()
  → 返回
```

这几步都只是有限次数的 power-table / RC 寄存器写，没有 semaphore、延时或轮询循环。校准完成后，接下来是：

```text
cfg_param_init()
→ rwnx_intf_init()
   → 创建 kmsgbk
   → 创建 core_thread
→ fhost_rxbuf_push()
→ wpas_thread_start()
→ bk_wifi_init complete
```

所以现在最需要确认的是：`kmsgbk` / `core_thread` 是否被创建、是否在运行，而不是继续盯着 `pwr_gain`。

请先不要再次执行 `bk7258_wifi_runtime init`；它会再启动一个后台初始化线程，反而混淆状态。直接在当前 NSH 执行：

```sh
ps
```

把完整输出贴来即可。

重点看是否出现这些任务：

```text
bk7258-wifi    # 发起 init 的后台线程
kmsgbk         # vendor 消息线程
core_thread    # vendor KE/event 线程
syswq          # Armino workqueue
```

这不需要 GDB。根据 `ps` 能立刻区分：

- `bk7258-wifi` 仍为 `Running`：卡在同步初始化路径；
- `bk7258-wifi` 消失，但没有 `bk_wifi_init complete`：线程异常退出或返回失败；
- `kmsgbk` / `core_thread` 已存在且等待 semaphore：初始化已越过校准和线程创建，问题在其后的 RX/WPA 启动；
- 只有 `bk7258-wifi`、没有上述 worker：范围收敛到 `rwnx_intf_init()` 的线程创建路径。

这份新 log 说明之前的判断需要纠正：

- `.noinit` tracing 不是根因；
- 自定义 semaphore wrapper 也不是根因；
- 即使已改成 Armino 的裸 counting-semaphore 语义，断言仍会出现。

已确认当前断言仍是：

```text
SysTick
→ nxsem_timeout()
→ nxsem_wait_irq()
→ sem_waitirq.c:137
```

而且 waiter 仍然是静态 idle TCB：

```text
R4 = 0x28070ca4 = g_idletcb
R3 = 0x28070ca0 = g_running_tasks
```

也就是说，某次有限等待的 timeout watchdog 最终关联到了 idle TCB；这不是 Armino 正常 `xSemaphoreTake()` 行为，也不能靠“再包一层 semaphore”解决。

我已经撤回了刚才临时加入的 `sched_idletask() -> -EDEADLK` 防护，因为它不是 Armino 原始实现，只会隐藏症状，不符合你说的“直接和 Armino 一样”。

最终待测镜像现在是纯粹的 Armino 对齐版：

```text
CreateCounting(max, 0) → nxsem_init(sem, 0, 0)
xSemaphoreTake         → nxsem_*wait_uninterruptible
xSemaphoreGive         → nxsem_post
vQueueDelete           → nxsem_destroy + kmm_free
```

并且已去掉：

```text
自定义 semaphore wrapper
max_count 软件限制
post 前手工计数检查
wrapper spinlock
wait tracing / .noinit trace
idle-context 临时保护
```

最终镜像已经重新通过 CP/AP 构建、L1、封包、独立解码与完整性校验：

```text
all-app.bin SHA-256
b33cfbbf8780141438d664afe03ffcc429907c50f63abf0cf891e110c152c2de
```

```bash
/home/czp/openvela_contest/contest2026_272_tokenwujixian/.claude/skills/bk7258-worktree-build/scripts/full_flow.sh \
  --image /home/czp/openvela_contest/cmake_out/bk7258-worktrees/bk7258-wifi-rebuild--e2507a8ee482/package/all-app.bin \
  --tools-dir /home/czp/openvela_contest/.worktrees/bk7258-wifi-rebuild/board/bk7258-devkit/tools \
  --flash \
  --device /dev/ttyUSB0
```

接下来不应该再修改 semaphore 行为。根因已收敛到更底层的“为什么有限等待被登记到 `g_idletcb`”——即调度上下文或 TCB/watchdog 状态损坏。没有 GDB 的情况下，要继续定位需要加入非常小的、一次性的调度状态记录；但这会是额外诊断改动，不是 Armino 对齐本身。我会先停在这个已验证的 Armino 等价镜像，不再继续猜测性改动。

结论：这次最强、且能和断言现场直接对应的回归候选，不是 `pwr_gain`，而是校准前把旧 SARADC shim 替换成了导入的 Armino `adc_driver.c`。

关键证据：

```text
上一个提交 5540f23：
  编译 glue/bk7258_saradc.c
  bk_adc_read_raw() 轮询 FIFO：
    up_udelay(10)
    while (elapsed < timeout)
  不创建 semaphore，不注册 ADC ISR，不产生 NuttX timed wait

当前未提交镜像：
  不再编译 glue/bk7258_saradc.c
  新增并实际链接 saradc/.../adc_driver.c
  bk7258_wifi_initialize() 在校准前新增：
    bk_adc_driver_init();
    bk_sensor_init();

  新 adc_driver.c：
    创建 s_adc_dev.adc_read_sema
    bk_adc_read_raw()
      → sys_drv_sadc_int_enable()
      → rtos_get_semaphore(&adc_read_sema, timeout)
```

PHY calibration 的 adapter 已明确绑定到这份新函数：

```c
._bk_adc_read_raw = bk_adc_read_raw;
```

而你的断言栈里多次出现：

```text
0x000003e8 = 1000 ms
```

新 ADC driver 恰好有这个有限等待：

```c
rtos_get_semaphore(&s_adc_dev.adc_read_sema, 1000);
```

它与现场完全吻合：

```text
校准输出 [adc] release
→ PHY 调 _bk_adc_read_raw()
→ 新 adc_driver 对 adc_read_sema 做 1000 ms timed wait
→ SysTick 的 nxsem_timeout()
→ sem_waitirq.c:137
```

因此目前应将它视为高置信度回归链：

```text
旧轮询 SARADC
        ↓ 被替换
新 ADC ISR + adc_read_sema + 1000 ms timed wait
        ↓
校准期间触发 NuttX timed-wait 一致性断言
```

关于“第一次不崩、复位后第二次才崩”：

第一次其实也没有正常完成。日志中的：

```text
!RST r0=00000 cp=00000 ap=00000
BK
...
NuttShell
```

说明板子在 `pwr_gain` 后已经发生重启；只是第一次重启前的故障输出没有完整刷到 UART。第二次运行才把同一个 timed-wait 问题完整打印为 `sem_waitirq.c:137`。所以这不是第一次成功、第二次才失败的 A/B 结果。

另外，已排除或降级的项：

- `.noinit` finite-wait tracing：已移除，断言仍存在；
- 自定义 `max_count + spinlock` semaphore wrapper：已移除，断言仍存在；
- `kmsgbk` / `core_thread` 优先级变化：它们在 `calibration_init()` 之后才创建，不能解释校准阶段的断言；
- `pwr_gain` 后的 power-table 函数：反汇编显示只是固定次数 MMIO 写，不含 wait、delay 或循环。

最小、干净的验证应该是一次单变量 A/B：

```text
保留当前其余改动，
仅恢复旧的 glue/bk7258_saradc.c 轮询实现，
并取消当前新增的 bk_adc_driver_init() / bk_sensor_init() 前置初始化，
不链接 saradc/.../adc_driver.c 与 temp_detect/bk7258_temp_detect.c。
```

如果恢复旧 SARADC shim 后校准不再触发 `sem_waitirq.c:137`，就能把回归因到这次“导入 ADC driver 并引入 ADC semaphore timed wait”的变更，而不是继续猜测 Wi‑Fi semaphore 或 `pwr_gain`。
但是旧版的adc读取是有问题的不是吗？那么我们现在是适配不充分，对比armino他的实现肯定是没有问题的呢为什么他不崩溃
你说得对：旧轮询版只是一个对照，不应当作为正式修复。更合理的问题是“同一份 Armino ADC driver 在 Armino 为何正常、搬到 NuttX 后哪个依赖契约没适配完整”。我会直接对照 Armino 的 ADC 获取/中断完成/RTOS 调用链与当前 NuttX port，先验证刚才把它定为“根因”的结论是否过度。

-float saradc_calculate(UINT16 adc_val)
-{
-    float practic_voltage;
-
-    /* (adc_val - low) / (practic_voltage - 1Volt) = (high - low) / 1Volt */
-    /* practic_voltage = (adc_val - low) / (high - low) + 1Volt */
-    practic_voltage = (float)(adc_val - saradc_val.low);
-    practic_voltage = (practic_voltage / (float)(saradc_val.high - saradc_val.low)) + 1;
-
-    if (practic_voltage < 0) {
-        practic_voltage = 0.0f;
-    }
-
-    return practic_voltage;
-}

-float bk_adc_data_calculate(UINT16 adc_val, UINT8 adc_chan)
-{
-    float cali_value = 0;
-
-    // CHx: 0:1/4 1:1/3 2:1/2 3:1/1
-    // CH0: 0:1/7 1:1/5 2:1/3 3:1/2
-    if (adc_chan == ADC_0)
-    {
-        switch (g_adc_cfg.vol_div)
-        {
-            case ADC_VOL_DIV_7:
-                adc_val = adc_val * 7 / 3;
-                break;
-            case ADC_VOL_DIV_3:
-                break;
-            case ADC_VOL_DIV_2:
-                adc_val = adc_val * 2 / 3;
-                break;
-            case ADC_VOL_DIV_5:
-            default:
-                adc_val = adc_val * 5 / 3;
-                break;
-        }
-    }
-    else
-    {
-        switch (g_adc_cfg.vol_div)
-        {
-            case ADC_VOL_DIV_4:
-                adc_val = adc_val * 4 / 3;
-                break;
-            case ADC_VOL_DIV_2:
-                adc_val = adc_val * 2 / 3;
-                break;
-            case ADC_VOL_DIV_1:
-                adc_val = adc_val * 1 / 3;
-                break;
-            case ADC_VOL_DIV_3:
-            default:
-                break;
-        }
-    }
-
-    if(adc_chan == 7 || adc_chan == 8 || adc_chan == 9 || adc_chan == 11)
-    {
-        ADC_LOGD("adc_chan %d has been used\r\n", adc_chan);
-    }
-    else
-    {
-        cali_value = saradc_calculate(adc_val);
-    }
-    return cali_value;
-}

是，你的判断是对的：旧版轮询 ADC 不是正确修复，不能为了躲开 `sem_waitirq` 就回退它。正确方向是保持 Armino 的 ADC driver，并把它依赖的 NuttX 适配补完整。

<thinking>
已确认当前移入的 `adc_driver.c` 与 Armino authority 主体一致；差异集中在 NuttX 的 RTOS semaphore、SARADC IRQ 分发与 SARADC 跨核/电源协调层。当前断言的 1000 ms 超时与 ADC driver 的 `adc_read_sema` 等待精确匹配，但 `g_idletcb` 作为 waiter 说明不是普通 ADC 超时，而是 NuttX 任务/等待状态的适配不变量已被破坏。
</thinking>

关键事实是：

```text
Armino ADC driver：
  adc_block_read(timeout)
    → 打开 SARADC 中断
    → xSemaphoreTake(adc_read_sema, timeout)
  SARADC ISR：
    → 采样完成
    → xSemaphoreGiveFromISR(adc_read_sema)

当前 NuttX port：
  adc_block_read(1000)
    → sys_drv_sadc_int_enable()
    → rtos_get_semaphore(adc_read_sema, 1000)
    → nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(...)
  SARADC ISR：
    → rtos_set_semaphore(adc_read_sema)
    → nxsem_post(...)
```

而你的断言现场有：

```text
0x000003e8 = 1000 ms
SysTick → nxsem_timeout() → nxsem_wait_irq()
```

这和新 ADC driver 中的 `rtos_get_semaphore(..., 1000)` 精确吻合：

- [adc_driver_part2.inc](/home/czp/openvela_contest/.worktrees/bk7258-wifi-rebuild/chips/bk7258/saradc/middleware/driver/saradc/adc_driver_part2.inc:134)
- [adc_driver_part3.inc](/home/czp/openvela_contest/.worktrees/bk7258-wifi-rebuild/chips/bk7258/saradc/middleware/driver/saradc/adc_driver_part3.inc:84)
- [NuttX semaphore adapter](/home/czp/openvela_contest/.worktrees/bk7258-wifi-rebuild/chips/bk7258/wifi/bk7258_wifi_osal.c:448)

旧 shim 的确不正确：它通过轮询 FIFO 避开了 ADC IRQ 和 semaphore 完成机制，所以它能作为“为什么断言消失”的对照，但不能作为正式实现。

Armino 不崩，不是因为它不做这个等待；它也做。差别是它的依赖环境是完整的：

```text
Armino：
ADC IRQ → FreeRTOS ISR → xSemaphoreGiveFromISR()
                         ↓
               等待中的原始 FreeRTOS task 被唤醒

NuttX port 当前：
ADC IRQ → BK IRQ 适配 → nxsem_post()
                         ↓
               timed waiter 最终却被记录成 g_idletcb
```

`g_idletcb` 绝不应是 ADC 的等待任务。你 dump 中的：

```text
R4 = 0x28070ca4 = g_idletcb
R3 = 0x28070ca0 = &g_running_tasks
```

说明出错不是“ADC 等待超时”这么简单，而是进入 timed wait 时，NuttX 的任务/等待对象状态已经不符合契约。正常超时应返回 `-ETIMEDOUT`，而不是让 idle TCB 出现在 `nxsem_timeout()` 中。

目前已确认的未完整适配点有三个：

1. SARADC IPC 仍是 stub  
   [nuttx_port.c](/home/czp/openvela_contest/.worktrees/bk7258-wifi-rebuild/chips/bk7258/saradc/nuttx_port/nuttx_port.c:52) 中：

   ```c
   bk_err_t mb_saradc_ipc_init(void)
   {
     return BK_OK;
   }
   ```

   但 Armino 的多核配置会打开 `MB_CHNL_SARADC`，并在 ADC acquire/release 时对另一核发 START/END、等待 ACK，保护 SARADC 的跨核所有权。我们现在把这层协调直接宣告成功，和 Armino 不等价。

2. SARADC IRQ 路径需要按 Armino 的完整契约验证  
   Armino 的 ADC ISR 在样本足够时 `GiveFromISR`；NuttX port 改成 BK ICU source → generic NuttX IRQ → `nxsem_post`。这本身可以成立，但必须确认：

   ```text
   SARADC source ID 正确
   CPU interrupt gate 正确
   NVIC/ICU 映射正确
   ISR 清状态的时序正确
   ISR 确实命中一次且只 post 一次
   ```

3. RTOS 当前任务上下文不一致  
   Armino 在 `xSemaphoreTake()` 中总能找到实际 FreeRTOS task。我们在 NuttX timed-wait 超时路径看到的是 idle TCB，这说明 `this_task()` / waiter / watchdog 的关联出了问题；这不是 ADC driver 原文件的逻辑错误。

所以正确修复路径不是：

```text
回退到旧轮询 ADC
```

而是：

```text
保留 authority ADC driver
→ 完成 SARADC IPC/所有权适配
→ 验证 SARADC IRQ → semaphore completion 链
→ 修复 NuttX timed waiter 为什么落到 g_idletcb
```

其中最优先的是 SARADC IPC：当前 port 把 Armino 的跨核协调降成 no-op，而第一次运行后复位、第二次再触发异常，正符合“硬件/跨核状态保留，但 NuttX BSS 状态重新初始化”的不一致形态。

我不会再把旧轮询实现作为正式修复，也不会继续改 Wi‑Fi 通用 semaphore 行为。下一步应只针对 `mb_saradc_ipc_init / mb_saradc_op_prepare / mb_saradc_op_finish` 和 SARADC IRQ 完成路径，按 Armino 的契约补齐。

1. SARADC IPC 仍是 stub  
   nuttx_port.c (/home/czp/openvela_contest/.worktrees/bk7258-wifi-rebuild/chips/bk7258/saradc/nuttx_port/nuttx_port.c:52) 中：
      bk_err_t mb_saradc_ipc_init(void)
   {
     return BK_OK;
   }
   
   但 Armino 的多核配置会打开 MB_CHNL_SARADC，并在 ADC acquire/release 时对另一核发 START/END、等待 ACK，保护 SARADC 的跨核所有权。我们现在把这层协调直接宣告成功，和 Armino 不等价。
2. SARADC IRQ 路径需要按 Armino 的完整契约验证  
   Armino 的 ADC ISR 在样本足够时 GiveFromISR；NuttX port 改成 BK ICU source → generic NuttX IRQ → nxsem_post。这本身可以成立，但必须确认：
      SARADC source ID 正确

   NVIC/ICU 映射正确
   ISR 清状态的时序正确
   ISR 确实命中一次且只 post 一次

   Armino 在 xSemaphoreTake() 中总能找到实际 FreeRTOS task。我们在 NuttX timed-wait 超时路径看到的是 idle TCB，这说明 this_task() / waiter / watchdog 的关联出了问题；这不是 ADC driver 原文件的逻辑错误。

而是：

→ 完成 SARADC IPC/所有权适配

→ 修复 NuttX timed waiter 为什么落到 g_idletcb 
帮我补齐呢？而且实现行为一致的适配nuttx
我会按 Armino 的三段契约补齐，而不是回退 ADC：先把 authority 的 SARADC mailbox START/END/ACK 流程与本地 RPMsg mailbox 能力逐项对照；再补齐 IRQ→一次 post 的边界；最后给 NuttX 的 timed wait 做可验证的任务上下文约束。为保证构建、封包和硬件边界一致，我继续使用 BK7258 worktree 构建流程。

    63	extern int mb_ipc_cpu_is_power_off(u32 cpu_id);
    64	
    65	static bk_err_t send_saradc_op_state(uint8_t state)
    66	{
    67		uint64_t us_start = 0;
    68		uint64_t us_end = 0;
    69	
    70		saradc_erase_ipc_state = IPC_SARADC_OP_REQ;
    71	
    72		mb_chnl_cmd_t  cmd_buf;
    73	
    74		cmd_buf.hdr.data = 0; /* clear hdr. */
    75		cmd_buf.hdr.cmd  = state;
    76		cmd_buf.param1 = saradc_erase_ipc_state;
    77	
    78		bk_err_t   ret_val = mb_chnl_write(MB_CHNL_SARADC, &cmd_buf);
    79	
    80		if(ret_val != BK_OK)
    81			return ret_val;
    82	
    83		us_start = bk_aon_rtc_get_us();
    84	
    85		for(int i = 0; i < 2000; i++)
    86		{
    87			if(saradc_erase_ipc_state == IPC_SARADC_OP_ACK)
    88			{
    89				break;
    90			}
    91	
    92			us_end = bk_aon_rtc_get_us();
    93			// wait ack time should not be more than 5 ms
    94			if((us_end - us_start) > SARADC_WAIT_ACK_TIMEOUT)
    95			{
    96				return BK_FAIL;
    97			}
    98		}
    99	
   100		return BK_OK;
   101	}

   109			return BK_OK;
   110		
   111		ret_val = send_saradc_op_state(IPC_SARADC_OP_START);
   112		#endif

   114		return ret_val;
   115	}

chips/bk7258/wifi/hal_port/hal_port_sys_int_power.c-14- * Why this exists (two independent defects in the previous shims):
chips/bk7258/wifi/hal_port/hal_port_sys_int_power.c-15- *
chips/bk7258/wifi/hal_port/hal_port_sys_int_power.c-16- * 1. INTERRUPT BANK. Armino splits the seven MAC interrupt enables across
chips/bk7258/wifi/hal_port/hal_port_sys_int_power.c-17- *    two registers: gen/prot/tx_trigger/rx_trigger/txrx_misc live in
chips/bk7258/wifi/hal_port/hal_port_sys_int_power.c-18- *    `cpu0_int_32_63_en` (sources 32-36 = bits 0-4 of the HIGH bank) while
chips/bk7258/wifi/hal_port/hal_port_sys_int_power.c-19- *    txrx_timer (bit31) and modem (wifi_int_phy_mpb) live in
chips/bk7258/wifi/hal_port/hal_port_sys_int_power.c-20- *    `cpu0_int_0_31_en` (LOW bank).  Our previous bulk init ORed the bit
chips/bk7258/wifi/hal_port/hal_port_sys_int_power.c-21- *    constants {0,1,2,3,4,31} and passed them to a helper that writes only
chips/bk7258/wifi/hal_port/hal_port_sys_int_power.c-22- *    the LOW bank, so bit31 landed correctly but bits 0-4 enabled five
chips/bk7258/wifi/hal_port/hal_port_sys_int_power.c-23- *    unrelated LOW-bank sources.  The MAC interrupts themselves were never
chips/bk7258/wifi/hal_port/hal_port_sys_int_power.c:24: *    starved -- `_bk_int_isr_register` routes through bk7258_icu_enable(),
chips/bk7258/wifi/hal_port/hal_port_sys_int_power.c-25- *    which dispatches source>=32 to INT_EN_HI correctly (board: `ICU enable
chips/bk7258/wifi/hal_port/hal_port_sys_int_power.c-26- *    source=36`, `isr36=1`) -- so this is a pollution fix, not the FSM
chips/bk7258/wifi/hal_port/hal_port_sys_int_power.c-27- *    blocker.
chips/bk7258/wifi/hal_port/hal_port_sys_int_power.c-28- *
chips/bk7258/wifi/hal_port/hal_port_sys_int_power.c-29- * 2. POWER-STATE GETTERS. Both getters returned a compile-time constant,
chips/bk7258/wifi/hal_port/hal_port_sys_int_power.c-30- *    and they disagreed with each other: platform_shim returned
chips/bk7258/wifi/hal_port/hal_port_sys_int_power.c-31- *    PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_NONE for every module while hw_driver_shim
chips/bk7258/wifi/hal_port/hal_port_sys_int_power.c-32- *    returned PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON for every module, though both
chips/bk7258/wifi/hal_port/hal_port_sys_int_power.c-33- *    should report the same register.  The authoritative wrappers
chips/bk7258/wifi/hal_port/hal_port_sys_int_power.c-34- *    (bk_wifi_adapter.c:261-264 and :346-349) are UNGUARDED pass-throughs,
chips/bk7258/wifi/hal_port/hal_port_sys_int_power.c-35- *    unlike the SoC-gated `sys_ll_*_pwd_ofdm_wrapper`, so BK7258 really
chips/bk7258/wifi/hal_port/hal_port_sys_int_power.c-36- *    does reach the register-reading implementations copied below.
